idea-plugin.name: OptionalGetter for Lombok
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for @OptionalGetter from the io.github.valuya:lombok overlay (a Project Lombok overlay whose @OptionalGetter generates a getXxxOptional() accessor returning Optional<T>).

The bundled Lombok plugin only knows Lombok's built-in annotations, so the generated getXxxOptional() methods otherwise show up as unresolved in the editor. This plugin injects them into IntelliJ's model, restoring code completion, find usages and go-to-declaration (which lands on the field). It does not run the annotation processor; the real accessor is still generated by the overlay at compile time.
